denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: May 30, 2022
Claim: Diagnostic mammogram, May 2022
Reason Code: CO-197

Benefits are not available for the above service. Prior authorization was required and was not
obtained. Please refer to Section 3.3 of your Certificate of Coverage.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Benefits are not available for the above service. Prior authorization was required and was not obtained.

sub_claims.text: Prior authorization was required and was not obtained.
sub_claims.rationale: While Section 3.3 of your Certificate of Coverage states that certain services require prior authorization before they are rendered, it does not specify which services fall under this requirement. Additionally, Section 3.4 lists several services that do not require prior authorization. Without more specific information about the service in question, it is insufficient to determine whether prior authorization was required and if it was obtained.
